map.：基础议价空间=车况良好(5%)+市场正常(0%)+车龄加成 min(8%,5×: : base negotiation room = good condition (5%) + normal market (0%) + age add-on min(8%, 5x1%=5%) + mileage correction (12/10=1.2 -> over 20% -> +2%) = 12%, limited to 12%. Reasonable transaction range = 20 x (1-12%) ~ 20 x (1-6%) = 17.6-18.8 ten-thousand yuan; suggested first bid = 20 x (1-12%) = 17.6 ten-thousand, target price approx 18.2 ten-thousand. Budget 18 ten-thousand is close to the target; need to push for the floor.
map.议价空间的上限是多少？: What is the upper limit of negotiation room?
map.基础空间（车况+热度+车龄+里程）限制在 2%~35%，再乘以谈判风格系数（稳健: The base space (condition + heat + age + mileage) is limited to 2%-35%, then multiplied by the negotiation-style factor (steady 0.6 / regular 1.0 / aggressive 1.4) and limited to 1%-30%. That is, no matter how bad the condition, the suggested first quote is at least 70% of the quoted price (aggressive style upper limit).
map.预测的成交区间准吗？: Is the predicted transaction range accurate?
map.模型基于经验系数估算，给出的是「谈判锚点」而非精确成交价；真实成交受车源稀缺度、: The model estimates from empirical coefficients; it gives a "negotiation anchor" rather than an exact transaction price; real transactions are affected by car scarcity, buyer urgency and regional market. Cross-validate with recent same-model transactions and inspection reports; this tool only aids pricing strategy.
